description:
You are an IT Project Manager at a professional services consulting firm. The sales team has just closed a major deal with Meridian Health Systems, a 500-bed hospital network. You need to set up the project communication infrastructure and coordinate the handoff from sales to delivery.

Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Perform the following actions:

1. Go to the #sales-handoffs channel and read the client briefing message for Meridian Health Systems to understand the project scope and requirements
2. Create a private channel named exactly: proj-meridian-internal (for the internal delivery team)
3. Set its topic to: Meridian Health Systems | EHR Integration Platform | $2.4M | Discovery: Mar-Apr 2026
4. Invite the delivery team: solutions.architect, delivery.lead, ux.designer, data.engineer
5. Post a project kickoff message in the internal channel that includes: (a) client overview from the briefing, (b) key technical requirements (HL7 FHIR, real-time sync, HIPAA logging), (c) identified risk factors, and (d) proposed timeline milestones
6. Pin the project kickoff message
7. Create a public channel named exactly: proj-meridian-client (for client-facing communication)
8. Set its topic to: Meridian Health Systems - EHR Integration Project | Client Communication Channel
9. Invite to the client channel: solutions.architect, delivery.lead, account.manager, client.sponsor
10. Post a welcome message in the client channel introducing the delivery team and confirming the project kickoff timeline
11. Reply in a thread on the client briefing message in #sales-handoffs confirming the handoff is complete and project channels are set up
12. Send a direct message to solutions.architect asking them to begin a technical assessment of the HL7 FHIR integration requirements and the legacy lab system API gap
